Hi Sharon,

Your book Anishinaabe Dreams pairs a short essay with a poem in each of its twenty-four chapters, moving from the Creation Story and the Seven Grandfathers to sugar bushing and powwows. As a member of the Sault Ste. Marie Tribe of Chippewa Indians, you bring a personal voice to teachings that many readers will want to hear.
